headline: Tech-driven airfreight boom fuels a blowout quarter
summary_short: Expeditors' Q2 2026 revenue rose to $3.50B (+32.1% y/y) as airfreight revenue jumped 57% on AI-infrastructure-driven tech demand, driving diluted EPS to $2.03 (+51.5% y/y) and net income to $266.2M (+45.0% y/y).
summary_long: Airfreight revenue rose 57% as tech customers ramped AI-infrastructure shipments, while ocean freight grew just 5% as buy/sell rates only began recovering late in the quarter after three quarters of declines. Customs brokerage rose 27% on rising clearance complexity and road-freight/warehousing demand. Salaries rose 22% on higher incentive pay and a $25M Global Technology restructuring charge (of ~$27M total planned). Operating income rose 41% to $349.6M and net income rose 45% to $266.2M ($2.03 diluted EPS). Operating cash flow was flat at $178.6M. The company repurchased $354.9M of stock and declared a $0.81/share semi-annual dividend; cash fell to $1.03B and equity to $2.12B on buybacks. No formal guidance was issued; 2026 capex is estimated at ~$60M.
